flowPlugins.name: ℹ️ IMPORTANT - This plugin is a PRO feature only, if you dont have Pro please check the README for the only workaround I can think of.
EXIT - FILE is already MKV and PROFILE 4/5 or 8, should not need further processing. Disable if filter if bypassing to re-encode
Stage 3 - DoVi Processing - EXTRACT + INJECT RPU
Dolby Vision Profile 7 - Will output as DoVi Profile 8
Checks if the HDR10 fallback metadata is missing, if it is, converting from a single to dual layer can help with playback issues on profile 7 conversions.
⛔️⛔️ ERROR - No Tags Found - Check Flow ⛔️⛔️
⛔️⛔️ ERROR - Either HDR10 or not HDR, Nothing to process in this flow ⛔️⛔️

ℹ️ Note - If you're running multiple flows, make sure this is the last one before saving or replacing. I've discovered that any further processing after this step may overwrite the DoVi data stored in the MKV file, rendering all the work you've done thus far useless.
Stage 3 - DoVi Processing - EXTRACT + INJECT + PACKAGE Metadata
Stage 3 - DoVi Processing - EXTRACT + INJECT RPU
HDR10+  - Will output as DoVi Profile 8
Dolby Vision Profile 7 - Will output as DoVi Profile 8
ℹ️ Filter by previously tagged type
ℹ️ The raw HEVC and srt streams are extracted from the file. Srt streams are moved to input directory and renamed. All audio streams including TrueHD and DCA are preserved in the final MKV output.

ℹ️ Important!! if incoming from another flow, or if any processing was done beforehand. One of the flow plugins will use the original file when repackaging, potentially removing any changes made earlier unless replaced with the changes made up to this point.

ℹ️ Important!! This will ensure the cusotm DoVI node is currently in use, if not the flow will fail as tools are missing. Ensure the custom node is tagged by going to the main dashboard - "Select the Custom Node > Options > Node Tags > DoVi_Yeezy"
ℹ️ This cleans up any metadata generated during processing.
Fail if output larger than original
Stage 3 - DoVi Processing - EXTRACT + INJECT RPU
Package DoVi 7 mkv (Dual > Single-Layer) (DISABLED - Direct HEVC→MKV)

ℹ️ At this point in any of the flows, if you wanted to re - encode the raw HEVC you need to do it at this point, right after the extract RPU and before the INJECT RPU. Just ensure you maintain the HDR10 fallback metadata as ffmpeg may strip it.
